card.subtitle: Synced by the agent on your computer
card.helper: IS/STAG is only reachable from the UPOL network (VPN). The agent on your computer downloads your schedule and subjects and sends them to Eduvio using an agent token. The token can only upload STAG data.

stale.old: The last sync is older than 14 days. Run the agent on a computer connected to the UPOL VPN.
stale.never: No sync has run yet. Run the agent on a computer connected to the UPOL VPN.

token.title: Agent token
token.none: The agent needs a token. Create one and paste it into the agent with the setup command.

confirm.regenerate: Create a new token? The current token stops working immediately and the agent will need to be set up again with the setup command.
confirm.revoke: Revoke the agent token? The agent stops syncing until you create a new token.

reveal.title: New agent token
reveal.warning: Copy it now and paste it into the agent (python3 stag_agent.py setup). You will not see it again after closing this.
